name: project-context-system
description: Agent context management that stays true: a compiled markdown wiki per project, a zero-dependency ctx CLI, and hooks that enforce it.

plugins.name: project-context-system
plugins.description: Scaffolds a self-maintaining context wiki (AGENTS.md, context/ pages, memory.md) and ships the ctx CLI plus SessionStart/Stop hooks so agent knowledge is compiled once and kept current instead of re-derived every session.
